lines.en: label yukispring4:
scene yukikaorishere1
: The words that fell from your mouth just now...how much truth do they possess?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说出口的那些话……有多少是真的？

lines.en: : You are...dying?
lines.zh: : 你……快死了？

lines.en: : You...weren’t supposed to hear any of that, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 你不该听到这些的，Kaori……

lines.en: : But...I {i}did{/i} hear it. And your appearance is not that of one who dies even if your color is less colorful now than it has been in the past.
lines.zh: : 可……我{i}确实{/i}听到了。而且你看起来不像是会死的人，哪怕你现在的气色不如从前。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...life fucking sucks. What do you want from me?
lines.zh: : 哼，那又怎样……人生就是他妈的烂。你想让我说什么？

lines.en: : Honesty...
lines.zh: : 实话……

lines.en: : If there is fear in your heart, it helps to have someone who will listen to its beating. Someone to strike fear into the heart of fear itself so the fear’s heart becomes fearful itself.
lines.zh: : 如果你心中有恐惧，那有人愿意倾听它的跳动会好受些。有人把恐惧打进恐惧自己的心里，让恐惧的心也变得害怕。

lines.en: : But I fear that you won’t do that. Which makes {i}me{/i} fearful.
lines.zh: : 但我怕你不会这么做。这让{i}我{/i}害怕。

lines.en: : Will I lose you too now?
lines.zh: : 现在连你也要失去了吗？

lines.en: : You...shouldn’t be here, Kaori...
lines.zh: : 你……不该在这儿，Kaori……

lines.en: : Why...{i}are{/i} you here anyway? I haven’t seen you in months.
lines.zh: : 你来这儿{i}到底{/i}干什么？我都好几个月没见过你了。

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere2
: My reasons lack importance now! What matters is that I {i}am{/i} here! Even if I am not the one you want, I am the one you have! So have me! Speak the words that deserve speaking!
lines.zh: : 我的理由现在已经不重要了！重要的是我{i}在{/i}这里！就算我不是你想要的那个，我也是你拥有的那个！那就拥有我吧！把该说的话说出来！

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere3
: But everything...becomes more {i}real{/i} when I start to talk about it...and I...it’s just...
lines.zh: : 可一旦我开始说出来，一切都……变得更{i}真实{/i}了……而我……只是……

lines.en: : Things have already become real now that there are tears where there haven’t been before.
lines.zh: : 事情早就已经真实了——因为现在有了以前没有的眼泪。

lines.en: : The Yukiburger I know is strong...And violent, but not necessarily in a negative way. She would not stand here in the dark with a wet face and an armful of secrets!
lines.zh: : 我认识的 Yukiburger 很强……而且很凶，但不一定是坏的那种凶。她绝不会站在黑暗里，满脸是泪，还抱着一怀的秘密！

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere4
: That Yuki’s already gone, Kaori...You get the {i}old{/i} me now. The one who’d trade anything and everything for one more night of feeling alive.
lines.zh: : 那个 Yuki 已经不在了，Kaori……你现在拿到的是{i}从前{/i}的我。那个愿意拿一切去换再多一个晚上、感受自己还活着的我。

lines.en: : And yeah...I’m probably dying. If you want the truth...I’m probably dying. Which means I might not have many nights left at all. So do yourself a favor and just...
lines.zh: : 而且……我大概是要死了。你要实话的话……我大概是要死了。也就是说，我剩下的夜晚可能根本没几个了。所以帮你自己一个忙，就……

lines.en: : Just bail out while you can, okay? Every second you stay here adds another day you’ll have to mourn me.
lines.zh: : 就趁还能走的时候走吧，好吗？你在这里多待一秒，将来就要多一天为我哀悼。

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere5
: And every second I am {i}not{/i} here adds another where you will be afraid.
lines.zh: : 而在我{i}不{/i}在这里的每一秒，你都会多一秒活在恐惧里。

lines.en: : I will mourn for however long you think it takes to prevent that for you. That is what it means to be family. I think.
lines.zh: : 只要能让你免于恐惧，你要我哀悼多久，我就哀悼多久。我想，这就是家人的意思吧。

lines.en: : Haven’t you mourned enough already?...
lines.zh: : 你哀悼得还不够多吗？……

lines.en: : If I have, I can’t remember it. So it’s like I’ve never mourned at all. Maybe I will enjoy it? And spending each day remembering you will not be as sad as you expect.
lines.zh: : 如果哀悼过，我也记不得了。所以就像我从来没哀悼过一样。也许我会享受它呢？而且每天回忆你，未必会像你想的那么悲伤。

lines.en: : Now explain to me — why are you leaving this place?
lines.zh: : 现在告诉我——你为什么要离开这个地方？

lines.en: : Please let me listen to your heart.
lines.zh: : 请让我听听你的心。

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere6

lines.zh: : 为什么？……

lines.en: : What’s even the point?
lines.zh: : 有什么意义？

lines.en: : It’s not like you’d hear anything if I did.
lines.zh: : 就算我说了，你也听不到什么。

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere7
: In fact, I don’t think it’s beaten a single fucking time since I was a teenager.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我觉得从我还是个少女起，它就一次他妈的都没跳过。

lines.en: : So...heh...maybe I’m overreacting?...
lines.zh: : 所以……呵……也许是我反应过度了？……

lines.en: : Maybe I’ve been dead this whole time and you’ve been cozying up to a fucking zombie pretending to still have some reason to be here.
lines.zh: : 也许我从头到尾都死了，而你一直贴着一个他妈的僵尸取暖，而这个僵尸还装作自己仍有留在这里的理由。

lines.en: : What’s that say about {i}you,{/i} huh? That you’d waste so much time and effort on something already beyond saving? Don’t you have better shit to do, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 那这说明了{i}你{/i}什么，嗯？你居然肯在一个早就没救的东西身上浪费这么多时间和精力？Kaori，你就没有更好的事可做吗？

lines.en: : Just get the fuck out of here, okay? You never should have come in the first place.
lines.zh: : 给我滚出去，好吗？你从一开始就不该来。

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere8
: You opened the door.
lines.zh: : 你开了门。

lines.en: : You would not have opened the door if you did not want to be saved. So there is something inside of you that is begging for help.
lines.zh: : 如果你不想被救，你是不会开门的。所以你心里有某个东西在乞求帮助。

lines.en: : Would you like me to keep you alive, Aunt Yuki?
lines.zh: : 要我把你救活吗，Yuki 阿姨？

lines.en: : And how would you do that, Kaori?...Not everyone can be fucking...Frankensteined back to life like you were. And not all of us {i}deserve{/i} it either.
lines.zh: : 你要怎么做呢，Kaori？……不是每个人都能像你那样被他妈的……像科学怪人似的拼回人间的。而且也不是我们每个人都{i}配{/i}。

lines.en: : It is not up to you to decide who is and is not worthy of life. The gods don’t like it when you pretend to be them, Aunt Yuki.
lines.zh: : 谁配活着、谁不配，不是你说了算的。神不喜欢你假扮成他们，Yuki 阿姨。

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere9
: What- you religious now? Is {i}that{/i} what you meant by “keeping me alive?” Think a prayer circle’s gonna fix my lungs?
lines.zh: : 什么——你现在信教了？你说的「救活我」就是{i}这个{/i}意思？觉得弄个祈祷圈就能把我的肺修好？

lines.en: : Not at all.
lines.zh: : 完全不是。

lines.en: : In fact, I think breathing as a whole isn’t all it’s cracked up to be.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我觉得呼吸这整件事，并没有大家吹的那么好。

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere10
scene yukikaorishere11
: Look at you — flailing around like a fish washed ashore, waiting for your bones to be picked clean by some sort of carnivorous bird.
lines.zh: : 看看你——像条被冲上岸的鱼一样扑腾，等着某种食肉的鸟把你的骨头啄干净。

lines.en: : What would you say to those who died fighting? Who actually {i}tried?{/i} That they were foolish for wanting to stay here — in a place that has so regularly {i}fucked{/i} you, Aunt Yuki?
lines.zh: : 那些战斗到死的人呢？那些真正{i}努力过{/i}的人呢？你要说他们想留在这里是愚蠢吗——留在一个这么频繁地{i}操{/i}你的地方，Yuki 阿姨？

lines.en: : Should {i}I{/i} have died too? For {i}I{/i} had done nothing to deserve life besides {i}want{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 那{i}我{/i}也该死吗？除了{i}想要{/i}活着，{i}我{/i}什么都没做，根本不配活着。

lines.en: : Or perhaps {i}I’ve{/i} become a zombie as well? Perhaps I {i}did{/i} die. And everything I do now is pointless and dull and just delaying an inevitable {i}second{/i} death.
lines.zh: : 或者也许{i}我也{/i}变成了僵尸？也许我{i}真的{/i}死了。而我现在做的一切都毫无意义、枯燥乏味，只是在推迟一场不可避免的{i}第二次{/i}死亡。

lines.en: : Jesus...between Yumi talkin’ to herself and your eyes fuckin’ changing colors, I’ve gotta be way higher than I thought I was.
lines.zh: : 天啊……一边是 Yumi 自言自语，一边是你的眼睛他妈的还会变色，我肯定比我以为的还要嗨。

lines.en: : Your time will most assuredly come — but only if the clock keeps ticking.
lines.zh: : 你的时刻必然会到来——但前提是时钟继续走。

lines.en: : Which means that all you need to do is stop it. And that’s much easier than it sounds, I think.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，你只需要让它停下来。而我觉得这比听上去容易得多。

lines.en: scene happy9
scene happy8
scene yukikaorishere12
: Ah.
: Yeah...you think a lot of shit, Kaori. And with all due respect, basically all of it is bullshit.
lines.zh: : 是啊……你想的破事真多，Kaori。恕我直言，基本上全是狗屁。

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere13
: But I’ve gotta applaud your...{i}positivity{/i} at least. You and Rika do a damn good job of making me slightly more optimistic about decomposing in the near future.
lines.zh: : 不过至少你的……{i}乐观{/i}我得鼓个掌。你和 Rika 真的很有一手，能让我对「不久的将来开始腐烂」这件事稍微乐观一点。

lines.en: : J...Just tell me what I can do to help you! Anything!
lines.zh: : 告、告诉我我能为你做什么！什么都行！

lines.en: : You got any money?...
lines.zh: : 你有钱吗？……

lines.en: : Money?
: Yeah...need it for laundry and shit like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……得拿去洗衣服什么的。

lines.en: : How many moneys do you require? My portable rectangle holder is inside of my housebox right now, so all I have are circles. Would you like the big circle? The medium circle? The small-
lines.zh: : 你需要多少张钱？我的便携式长方形收纳器现在在我的房子盒子里，所以我身上只有圆形的。你想要大圆？中圆？还是小——

lines.en: : I...uhh...I can wait until you have your...{i}rectangle holder{/i} again. Got...lots of clothes to wash...
lines.zh: : 我……呃……我可以等你拿回你的……{i}长方形收纳器{/i}再说。我……有很多衣服要洗……

lines.en: : I know this is true because you are currently naked. I thank you for no longer lying to me.
lines.zh: : 我知道这是真的，因为你现在是裸着的。谢谢你不再对我撒谎了。

lines.en: : But what about fixing your body? How many moneys-
lines.zh: : 可是治好你的身体呢？多少张钱——

lines.en: : Nothing’s fixing me, Kaori. It ain’t happenin’.
lines.zh: : 治不好我的，Kaori。不可能的。

lines.en: : But there’s shit that can make what’s left of my time here more bearable...and it just...
lines.zh: : 不过有些东西能让我在这儿的剩余时间好过一点……只是……

lines.en: : I feel more comfortable focusin’ on that instead of what comes after...
lines.zh: : 我觉得与其去想之后的事，不如专注在这上面更自在……

lines.en: scene black
scene yukikaorishere14
Despite the incessant pleas for her departure, Kaori Kadowaki refused to leave her aunt’s side — offering up her lap as a pillow in the dying woman’s time of need.
lines.zh: 尽管被反复请求离开，Kaori Kadowaki 拒绝离开她姨母的身边——在这个将死之人需要的时候，把自己的腿当成了枕头。

lines.en: But was she {i}really{/i} dying at all? Because {i}dying{/i} implies that a result will be reached. And based on what the girl inside of the girl said, that would require some help from time itself.
lines.zh: 可她{i}真的{/i}在死吗？因为「{i}死{/i}」意味着会有一个结果。而按那个「女孩中的女孩」的说法，那还需要时间本身的配合。

lines.en: If that final day could never be reached, would it really still be {i}dying?{/i} Or would she simply just be sick?
lines.zh: 如果最后那一天永远无法到来，那还能算是{i}在死{/i}吗？还是说，她只是病了？

lines.en: These are the questions I must ask myself as an observer deprived of the facts that would necessitate the completion of an unending thought.
lines.zh: 这是一个被剥夺了事实、因而无法完成一个无尽念头的观察者，必须问自己的问题。

lines.en: And this thought is just one that serves as the foundation for this place as a whole.
lines.zh: 而这个念头，正是这个地方整体的地基。

lines.en: {i}What if{/i} the ones we loved could never leave?
lines.zh: {i}如果{/i}我们爱的人永远无法离开呢？

lines.en: What if {i}everyone{/i} loved us in general?
lines.zh: 如果{i}所有人{/i}都爱我们呢？

lines.en: How would that world look? And if you were to somehow, by unconventional means, find out how to venture outside of it — how would things look {i}there?{/i}
lines.zh: 那样的世界会是什么样子？而如果你以某种非常规的方式，找到了走出它的办法——{i}那边{/i}看起来又会是什么样？

lines.en: Maybe you’d be an unwelcome visitor in someone else’s paradise?
lines.zh: 也许你会是别人天堂里一个不受欢迎的访客？

lines.en: Maybe you already {i}are?{/i}
lines.zh: 也许你已经{i}是{/i}了？

lines.en: In any case — squatters have rights too. And Yuki Yamaguchi was {i}all{/i} too familiar with this as she’d spent the vast majority of her life sleeping anywhere she could find.
lines.zh: 不管怎样——擅自占住的人也有权利。而 Yuki Yamaguchi 对此{i}再{/i}熟悉不过了，因为她人生中大部分时间都在任何能找到的地方睡觉。

lines.en: That said, if she were to die in this room, that alone could be called a victory — albeit one much too small for how hard she’d fought to get here.
lines.zh: 话虽如此，如果她死在这个房间里，单凭这一点就可以算是一场胜利——尽管对她一路拼到这里的辛苦来说，这场胜利小得可怜。

lines.en: Unfortunately, with no source of income, {i}this{/i} could be gone at any moment. And the chances of her continuing her fight dwindled by the minute as her opponent was a dragon this time.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，没有收入来源，{i}这一切{/i}随时可能消失。而她继续战斗下去的几率每分钟都在减少，因为这一次她的对手是一条龙。

lines.en: And despite Yuki having been a bit of a dragon herself in her younger years, those days were long gone. She healed slower. Got tired quicker. Lacked any sort of substantial motivation.
lines.zh: 尽管 Yuki 年轻时也算是条龙，但那些日子早就过去了。她愈合得更慢。累得更快。缺乏任何实质的动力。

lines.en: But the thing that pushed her closer to retirement wasn’t any of that. In fact, it was something much simpler.
lines.zh: 但真正把她推向退役的并不是这些。事实上，是某个简单得多的东西。

lines.en: She just didn’t know what she was even trying to “win” anymore.
lines.zh: 她只是不知道自己还在试图「赢」什么。

lines.en: What was the prize? Just more of {i}this?{/i}
lines.zh: 奖品是什么？就是更多的{i}这种{/i}日子？

lines.en: More pain?
lines.zh: 更多的痛苦？

lines.en: More knowing that something terrible could happen at any moment and take everything away?
lines.zh: 更多地知道，可怕的事随时可能发生，把一切夺走？

lines.en: She was right to be scared.
lines.zh: 她害怕是对的。

lines.en: And everyone who isn’t is wrong.
lines.zh: 而不害怕的人都是错的。

lines.en: But does that mean one should just give up?
lines.zh: 可那就意味着该放弃吗？

lines.en: This is one more question I must ask myself as an observer deprived of the facts that would necessitate the completion of an unending thought.
lines.zh: 这是又一个被剥夺了事实、因而无法完成一个无尽念头的观察者必须问自己的问题。

lines.en: Just there is no thought {i}more{/i} unending than the one currently swimming through the drug-addled mind of a thankless burnout.
lines.zh: 只是没有什么念头，比此刻正游过一个被毒品泡坏的、不知好歹的废人脑海里的那个{i}更{/i}无尽了。

lines.en: : I’m scared, Kaori...
lines.zh: : 我好害怕，Kaori……

lines.en: : I know, Aunt Yuki...
lines.zh: : 我知道，Yuki 阿姨……

lines.en: : I don’t want to die...
lines.zh: : 我不想死……

lines.en: : You {i}won’t...{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}不会{/i}的……

lines.en: : You will stay here...and we will go somewhere nice with Nao-chan. Somewhere with all the dizzy drinks and smoke-tubes your heart could ever desire.
lines.zh: : 你会留在这里……然后我们会和 Nao-chan 一起去个好地方。一个有你心里想要的所有晕眩饮料和烟管的地方。

lines.en: : Don’t give me hope...it’s the last thing I need.
lines.zh: : 别给我希望……那是我最不需要的东西。

lines.en: : But it {i}could{/i} be the first.
lines.zh: : 但它{i}可能{/i}是你最需要的。

lines.en: : What if hope is {i}all{/i} you need? And everything else comes after?
lines.zh: : 如果希望就是你需要的{i}全部{/i}呢？而其他的都在它之后到来？

lines.en: : That sort of thing doesn’t save people. Just makes them angrier when it don’t work out the way they want.
lines.zh: : 那种东西救不了人。只会让事情不如愿的时候，人更愤怒。

lines.en: : Knew this girl once...young. Got attacked one night. Found her beaten so bad she couldn’t move.
lines.zh: : 我以前认识一个女孩……很年轻。有天晚上被人袭击了。我们发现她的时候，她被打得动都动不了。

lines.en: : We rushed her to the hospital. Stayed there for a week, livin’ off of free coffee and food we’d snatch off carts left out in the halls.
lines.zh: : 我们把她送到医院。在那儿待了一个星期，靠免费咖啡和从走廊里推车上顺来的食物过活。

lines.en: : Did you not drink the juice? I drank many juices when I was in the hospital. So many that I became juice myself.
lines.zh: : 你们不喝果汁吗？我住院的时候喝了很多果汁。多到我自己都变成了果汁。

lines.en: : Sometimes, maybe? But anyway, five days in, girl regained some feeling in her legs. Doctors said it was a good sign. That she might be able to walk again if things kept improving.
lines.zh: : 也许偶尔喝过？总之，进院的第五天，那女孩的腿恢复了一点知觉。医生说这是好兆头。说如果情况继续好转，她也许能重新走路。

lines.en: : And...did they?...
lines.zh: : 然后……好转了吗？……

lines.en: : What do {i}you{/i} think?...Wouldn’t be tellin’ this story if it had a happy ending.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}觉得呢？……要是有个圆满结局，我就不会讲这个故事了。

lines.en: : We all got in on it. Started hyping her up. Tellin’ her she’d be fine in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 我们全都掺和进去了。开始给她打气。告诉她很快就会好起来的。

lines.en: : Day seven, the feeling was gone again. Just...went away.
lines.zh: : 第七天，那感觉又没了。就那么……消失了。

lines.en: : And never came back.
lines.zh: : 而且再也没回来过。

lines.en: : Still remember the look on her face. The...realization. Panic. The tone of the doc’s voice from the hallway when we heard him ordering more tests.
lines.zh: : 我还记得她脸上的表情。那种……醒悟。恐慌。还有我们在走廊上听到医生加开检查时，他说话的语气。

lines.en: : She was a little fireball, that girl. Started throwin’ shit around and screaming at the nurses about how fucked up it was to make her think she had a shot at bein’ normal again.
lines.zh: : 那女孩是个小火球。开始乱扔东西，冲着护士尖叫，说让他们以为自己还有机会变回正常人，这他妈有多操蛋。

lines.en: : That’s when they made us leave. Surprised they let us stay as long as they did, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 那时他们把我们赶走了。说实话，他们能让我们待那么久，我还挺意外的。

lines.en: : But ever since then, I’ve had a hard time tryin’ to look on the bright side when it comes to shit like this. Think that expectin’ the best just makes anythin’ {i}else{/i} feel like the worst.
lines.zh: : 但从那以后，遇到这种事我就很难往好处想了。我觉得，期待最好的结果，只会让任何{i}其他{/i}结果都显得像最糟的。

lines.en: : I don’t want my last thoughts on this planet to be cursin’ out whoever it is that made me think I had a shot.
lines.zh: : 我不想在这个星球上的最后念头，是咒骂那个让我以为自己还有机会的人。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Aunt Yuki...
lines.zh: : 对不起，Yuki 阿姨……

lines.en: : I don’t know what other words would help right now...
lines.zh: : 我不知道还有什么话能帮上忙……

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere15
: I already told you...there ain’t nothin’ that can help, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 我说过了……没有什么能帮得上忙，Kaori。

lines.en: : But...thank you for being here...
lines.zh: : 不过……谢谢你在这儿……

lines.en: : It’s nice...this warmth...
lines.zh: : 真好……这份温暖……

lines.en: : If only you did not have so much laundry to feed to the clean-machine. Then you could put on a thick jacket-coat and become even less cold.
lines.zh: : 要是你没有那么多衣服要喂给清洁机器就好了。那样你就能穿上一件厚外套，变得更不冷一点。

lines.en: : Do not worry, Yukiburger. Soon, I will provide you with all of the paper rectangles in my-
lines.zh: : 别担心，Yukiburger。很快，我就会把我所有的纸长方形都给你——

lines.en: : Just keep the money, Kaori. I changed my mind.
lines.zh: : 钱你自己留着吧，Kaori。我改主意了。

lines.en: : What? But how will you-
lines.zh: : 什么？可你要怎么——

lines.en: : I got one lifeline, still. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我还有一根救命稻草呢。别担心。

lines.en: : You mind doin’ somethin’ else for me, though? Doesn’t have to be now, just...whenever I’m gone.
lines.zh: : 不过你能再帮我做件事吗？不一定要现在，就……等我走了之后。

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere16
: I do not like the idea of making a promise that will only matter after you have left me behind.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢许下一个只有在你丢下我之后才作数的承诺。

lines.en: : It’s {i}because{/i} I’m leavin’ you behind that I’m askin’ at all.
lines.zh: : 正{i}因为{/i}我要丢下你，我才问的。

lines.en: : Then...what would you like from me?
lines.zh: : 那……你想要我做什么？

lines.en: : Kaori, I...know you don’t remember her...and I know she’ll probably make it difficult for you, but...
lines.zh: : Kaori，我……我知道你不记得她了……我也知道她大概会让你很为难，可是……

lines.en: : If you could look after Yumi when I’m gone...I’d really appreciate that...
lines.zh: : 如果我不在了，你能照顾 Yumi 的话……我真的会感激不尽……

lines.en: : The Yumi is your daughterburger, yes?
lines.zh: : Yumi 就是你的女儿堡，对吧？

lines.en: : That’s right...and your cousin...
lines.zh: : 没错……也是你表妹……

lines.en: : You two would play together when you were little...you were kind of like a role model to her...being older and...shit like that...
lines.zh: : 你们小时候会一起玩……你有点像是她的榜样……因为你年纪大些，还有……之类的……

lines.en: : Can you tell me what sorts of roles I modeled so I may better replicate our prior connection when you have departed?
lines.zh: : 你能告诉我，我当时示范了什么样的角色吗？这样在你离开之后，我就能更好地重现我们以前的关系。

lines.en: : I ain’t askin’ you to be your old self and take her under your wing or anything like that, just...
lines.zh: : 我不是要你变回从前的自己，或者把她收到翅膀底下之类的，只是……

lines.en: : She could use some friends...and I know you like makin’ em...
lines.zh: : 她需要一些朋友……而我知道你喜欢交朋友……

lines.en: : But what if she doesn’t like me? There are many people who seem to misunderstand the person I am.
lines.zh: : 可要是她不喜欢我呢？似乎有很多人误解我是个什么样的人。

lines.en: : Honestly, she probably {i}won’t{/i} like you. It won’t be personal, though. She doesn’t like anybody.
lines.zh: : 说实话，她大概{i}不会{/i}喜欢你。不过这不是针对你。她谁都不喜欢。

lines.en: : Then why do you want me to-
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还要我——

lines.en: : Because you’re all she’ll have.
lines.zh: : 因为你是她仅剩的人了。

lines.en: : You and that fuckin’ blonde girl who nearly killed Gary at least...but she doesn’t like me much and I can’t imagine she’d feel any better about me {i}now.{/i}
lines.zh: : 至少还有你，和那个差点弄死 Gary 的金发丫头……不过她不太喜欢我，我想她{i}现在{/i}对我的感觉也不会好到哪儿去。

lines.en: : Does the Yumi know that you think you are dying as well?
lines.zh: : Yumi 知道你也觉得自己要死了吗？

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere17
: I don’t just {i}think{/i} it...I know it. It’s real, Kaori. And yeah...Yumi knows. She found out by bein’ a fuckin’ nosy bitch. Same as you.
lines.zh: : 我不只是{i}觉得{/i}……我知道。这是真的，Kaori。而且……Yumi 知道。她是靠当个多管闲事的贱人发现的。跟你一样。

lines.en: : Guess it runs in the family.
lines.zh: : 看来这是家族遗传。

lines.en: : I am sorry that I overheard your secret...but I am also glad because it brought us together.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉我偷听到了你的秘密……但我也很高兴，因为它让我们走到了一起。

lines.en: : Mhm...sure...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……随便吧……

lines.en: : Now, you gonna tell me why you came over here in the first place? Or do you want me to go fuck myself one last time before I can’t anymore?
lines.zh: : 那么，你打算告诉我你到底为什么过来了吗？还是你想让我在再也做不了之前，最后一次去操我自己？

lines.en: : I can give you privacy if that is something you would like to do. I do not believe I am supposed to watch other people’s private time.
lines.zh: : 如果你想那么做的话，我可以给你隐私。我觉得我不该看别人的私人时间。

lines.en: : Not like that, you fucking idiot.
lines.zh: : 不是那个意思，你这白痴。

lines.en: : I am sorry, Aunt Yukiburger. I am still only a fucking novice.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Yukiburger 阿姨。我还只是个他妈的新手。

lines.en: : Whatever you are, promise me you’ll look after Yumi...okay?
lines.zh: : 不管你是什么，答应我你会照顾 Yumi……好吗？

lines.en: : I’m trusting you to do what I couldn’t.
lines.zh: : 我把我做不到的事托付给你了。

lines.en: : Please...it’d...
lines.zh: : 求你了……那会……

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere18
: Make me...
lines.zh: : 让我……

lines.en: scene yukikaorishere19
: Mn...hngh!
lines.zh: : Mn……hngh！

lines.en: : Aunt Yukiburger?! Is it happening?! Should I dial the numbers?!
lines.zh: : Yukiburger 阿姨？！是来了吗？！要我拨号码吗？！

lines.en: : Just a...sudden headache! Don’t...worry about it!
lines.zh: : 只是……突然头疼！别……别担心！

lines.en: scene black
: I will obtain the blood of the ocean for you to consume! Stay right there!
lines.zh: : 我去给你弄来海洋之血给你喝！就待在那儿别动！

lines.en: : There’s...a can of beer I haven’t finished near the-
lines.zh: : 附近有……一罐我还没喝完的啤酒——

lines.en: : Refused! The ocean blood will fix your head. You have not done enough of the hydrating.
lines.zh: : 驳回！海洋之血能治好你的头。你补水补得还不够。

lines.en: : Mn...aah...f...fine! Just fucking...ngh!
lines.zh: : Mn……啊……妈、……好吧！就他妈的……ngh！

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
I hope that Yuki was able to tell Yumi everything tonight.
lines.zh: 我希望 Yuki 今晚能把一切都告诉 Yumi。

lines.en: But more than that, I hope that Yumi was able to understand it.
lines.zh: 但更重要的是，我希望 Yumi 能听懂。

lines.en: And I hope that soon enough, I’ll be able to as well.
lines.zh: 也希望不久之后，我也能听懂。

lines.en: scene black
I crawl into bed beside someone who’s already asleep and silently whisper “goodnight” to her.
lines.zh: 我爬上床，躺在一个已经睡着的人身边，无声地对她说了句「晚安」。

lines.en: And while I half-expect to hear someone uninvited whisper it back from the corner of the room, there is nothing but silence.
lines.zh: 我虽半期待着会有个不请自来的声音，从房间角落里把它回给我，但什么都没有，只有寂静。

lines.en: There is nothing but silence.
lines.zh: 什么都没有，只有寂静。

lines.en: There is nothing.
lines.zh: 什么都没有。
